purpose: Observe longer pinned-model transients in a separate exploratory closed-loop model-space world experiment
temporal_rationale: Two existing 20 ms membrane time constants provide an observation window for model transients; no biological horizon or spike requirement is inferred
trajectory_rationale: Keep the existing unit object radius and initial four-radius separation; end at two radii after the frozen horizon, yielding velocity (2-4)/40=-0.05 world_eq/ms
geometry_proof: For stationary body and 0<=t<=40, forward separation 4-0.05*t lies in [2,4], strictly above the one-radius safety margin; atan2(1,d) is finite and floor(10*angle) is an integer from 2 through 4, accepted by the existing lattice primitive
freeze_statement: All parameters selected and serialized before any neural execution of this new scenario; criteria use model time constants and geometry only, never spike count, threshold crossing, actuation or displacement
